name: Scout v4
title: Scout v4
note: Scout v4 shape design (8 Nov, Spark: new props, no Bee35, everything printed in PCTG, still seats in the landing funnel for the battery swapper): Gemfan 5125 props on a printed frame, the v3 base and battery unchanged, a half cage on the new discs. -160..160 x -160..160 x -44..78 mm, ~767 g (E). tools/scout_v4_shape.py

parts.name: frame v4 (printed PCTG deck, arms and motor pods: the envelope)
parts.note: replaces the Bee35 plate: deck x -60..60, |y| 40, z 18.5..24.5 (the plate's underside kept, the units bolt up into it), arms 18 wide to O30 pods at (+-74.3, +-74.3); mass at 45 % of the envelope (E, the engine sizes it)

parts.name: base v4 (the v3 nose and tail units' envelope: runners, keel, camera and tail booms)
parts.note: the v3 base kept so the funnel seat and the swapper do not change: runners on the 184 x 66.8 outline at z -44.3 with 55 deg lead-ins, keel |y| 33.4 to the deck, the receiver's room cut; nose boom to the camera and NB, tail boom to TB; mass at 30 % of the envelope (E)
